import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('docs/operations/evidence/2026-11-13-queue1-review/nonrule-audit')
report=json.loads((base/'application-review-final.json').read_text())
inventory=Path('docs/migration/g0/inventory_status.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(inventory.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==report['current_inventory_sha256']
for name,digest in report['input_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
links=0
for file in base.glob('application-review*'):
    if not file.is_file() or file.suffix not in {'.md','.py','.json','.jsonl'}:
        continue
    assert all(line==line.rstrip() for line in file.read_text().splitlines()),file
    if file.suffix=='.md':
        for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',file.read_text()):
            assert (file.parent/target).is_file(),target
            links+=1
result={'result':'passed','inventory_sha256':report['current_inventory_sha256'],
        'scope_keys':report['scope_key_count'],'local_markdown_links':links,
        'source_file_line_refs':report['source_file_line_refs_checked'],
        'source_files_hashed':len(report['source_sha256']),
        'corrected_initial_findings':len(report['corrected_initial_findings']),
        'unresolved_application_findings':len(report['unresolved_findings']),
        'product_tests_run':0,'new_equivalence_signoffs':0}
with (base/'application-review-integrity.json').open('x') as target:
    json.dump(result,target,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    target.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
